content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text treats the challenger's footed chain as overcome by the single sentence's own words, rather than weighing the two chains by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the sentence's own words state: either it merely identifies the link's own footing, permitted, or it uses a single verse's own words as decisive against the challenger's read-together chain, the retired stating-verse test.", "why": "The judge uses Matthew 1:20's own words as the decisive contrary against the challenger's read-together chain, which is the verse-by-verse/stating-verse move K-C retires."}
